writingStages.description: Notice the shape and direction, then trace it with a model still visible.
Copy a glyph, word, or short phrase with stroke or formation cues.
Look, hide the model briefly, write, then compare and repair.
Turn a heard or romanized item into the target writing system.
Choose and order known language to write an original word, phrase, or sentence.
Write connected sentences for a real purpose and a named reader.
Complete a level-appropriate writing task under the target assessment's timing and rubric.
